# netbox_available_prefix (Data Source)

The free child prefixes of a NetBox prefix (ipam.prefix): one entry per contiguous free block, as NetBox's available-prefixes endpoint lists them. Reading allocates nothing; the netbox_available_prefix resource allocates.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_prefix" "test" {
  prefix = "192.0.2.0/24"
  status = "container"
}

data "netbox_available_prefix" "test" {
  prefix_id = netbox_prefix.test.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `prefix_id` (Number) Id of the prefix whose free space is listed.

### Read-Only

- `available_prefixes` (Attributes List) The free blocks, in address order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--available_prefixes))

<a id="nestedatt--available_prefixes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `available_prefixes`

Read-Only:

- `family` (Number) IP family of the block, 4 or 6.
- `prefix` (String) The free block in CIDR notation, e.g. 10.0.1.0/24.
- `vrf_id` (Number) Id of the VRF the block belongs to; unset in the global table.
